about.title: About Yahnu
about.mission_statement: We are on a mission to bridge the gap between education and employment, creating a thriving ecosystem for talent to connect with opportunity in {country} and beyond.
about.story_content_1: Founded by a team of educators and entrepreneurs, Yahnu was born from a shared vision: to unlock the immense potential of graduates by directly connecting them with the industries that need their skills. We saw a disconnect between the classroom and the workplace and set out to build the bridge.
about.story_content_2: Today, Yahnu is a dynamic platform that empowers students to launch their careers, helps companies find the right talent efficiently, and enables schools to forge meaningful industry partnerships. We believe in building futures, one connection at a time.
about.our_mission_content: To empower graduates, companies, and schools by creating a seamless and efficient ecosystem for talent development and career growth.
about.our_vision_content: To be the leading platform for professional connection and opportunity in Africa, driving economic growth and individual success.
about.our_values_content: Integrity, Innovation, Collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to the success of our users.

This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You.

Interpretation and Definitions

Interpretation

The words of which the initial letter is capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or in plural.

Definitions

For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

  • Account means a unique account created for You to access our Service or parts of our Service.
  • Company (referred to as either "the Company", "We", "Us" or "Our" in this Agreement) refers to Yahnu.
  • Cookies are small files that are placed on Your computer, mobile device or any other device by a website, containing the details of Your browsing history on that website among its many uses.
  • Country refers to: Côte d'Ivoire
  • Device means any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cellphone or a digital tablet.
  • Personal Data is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
  • Service refers to the Website.
  • Usage Data refers to data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself (for example, the duration of a page visit).
  • You means the individual accessing or using the Service, or the company, or other legal entity on behalf of which such individual is accessing or using the Service, as applicable.

Collecting and Using Your Personal Data

Types of Data Collected

Personal Data

While using Our Service, We may ask You to provide Us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify You. Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:

  • Email address
  • First name and last name
  • Phone number
  • Usage Data

Use of Your Personal Data

The Company may use Personal Data for the following purposes:

  • To provide and maintain our Service, including to monitor the usage of our Service.
  • To manage Your Account: to manage Your registration as a user of the Service. The Personal Data You provide can give You access to different functionalities of the Service that are available to You as a registered user.

Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update Our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify You of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

We will let You know via email and/or a prominent notice on Our Service, prior to the change becoming effective and update the "Last updated" date at the top of this Privacy Policy.

You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

company_1_description:
Orange Côte d'Ivoire is the leading telecommunications provider in West Africa, offering innovative mobile, internet, and mobile payment services. We connect communities and enable digital transformation across the region.

Join our dynamic team and help shape the future of telecommunications in Africa. We're looking for passionate talent to help us continue our mission of connecting everyone.
company_2_description:
SIFCA is Africa's leading agribusiness company, specializing in palm oil, natural rubber, and sugar. We are committed to sustainable agriculture and innovation across the African continent.

Join our team and help feed Africa while preserving our environment. We offer exciting career opportunities in modern, sustainable agriculture.
company_3_description:
Bridge Bank Group is a modern bank revolutionizing financial services in Africa. We offer innovative digital banking solutions tailored to the unique needs of the African market.

Be part of our mission to democratize access to financial services and drive economic growth across Africa through innovative banking solutions.
company_4_description:
Ceva Logistics is a global leader in supply chain and logistics solutions with a strong presence in Africa. We connect Africa to the world through our integrated logistics solutions and local expertise.

Join our international team and help facilitate trade and economic development across Africa with our cutting-edge logistics solutions.

schools.school_5_name: École Nationale Supérieure de Statistique et d'Économie Appliquée
schools.school_desc_1: Leading polytechnic institute specializing in engineering and technology education in West Africa.
schools.school_2_description: Prestigious public university offering comprehensive programs in sciences, humanities and professional studies.
schools.school_3_description: Premier private institution providing quality education in engineering, business and technology.
schools.school_4_description: Leading higher education institution specializing in Information and Communication Technologies in Africa.
schools.school_5_description: National school of statistics and applied economics, training professionals in economics and statistics.
schools.school_1_description: The Institut National Polytechnique Félix Houphouët-Boigny (INP-HB) is Côte d'Ivoire's premier polytechnic institute, established in 1996. Located in Yamoussoukro, the political capital, INP-HB is renowned for its excellence in engineering, technology, and applied sciences education. The institute offers programs in civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science, and telecommunications, preparing students for leadership roles in industry and public service.
schools.school_2_description: Université Félix Houphouët-Boigny (UFHB) is one of Côte d'Ivoire's most prestigious public universities, located in Abidjan. Established in 1964, it offers comprehensive programs across multiple faculties including Medicine, Law, Economics, Sciences, and Humanities. UFHB is known for its research excellence and has produced many of the country's leaders in various fields.
schools.school_3_description: Groupe CSI Pôle Polytechnique is a leading private higher education institution in Côte d'Ivoire, offering quality education in engineering, business, and technology. Located in Abidjan, CSI focuses on practical, industry-oriented training that prepares students for immediate employment in their chosen fields.
schools.school_4_description: École Supérieure Africaine des TIC (ESATIC) is a specialized higher education institution focused on Information and Communication Technologies. Located in Abidjan, ESATIC trains the next generation of IT professionals for Africa's growing digital economy.
schools.school_5_description: École Nationale Supérieure de Statistique et d'Économie Appliquée (ENSEA) is a prestigious institution specializing in statistics, economics, and applied mathematics. Based in Abidjan, ENSEA trains professionals who become key players in economic planning and statistical analysis across Africa.
